No invented source authority or document-majority-as-proof. Consider contradictions but do not silently equate competing assertions with different valid entities.
Make justified edits to the R5 set with full complementary coverage. Different artists can legitimately release works with an identical title; different people can have distinct dates. Uncertainty about a claim is different from a wrong requested role. Keep supported alternate referents rather than one familiar winner. Explicit memory checks are fallible. Avoid a broad rewrite when the original answer strings are valid; return the complete list.
